title: 3 Ruins Claim to Be Sodom
author: QUILL
notes: Three candidates, all dashed. The 2021 airburst paper is only 'disputed'. Not-proven line in beat 9.

beats.text: Three Bronze Age ruins claim to be Sodom.
beats.say: Three Bronze Age ruins claim to be SOD-um.

beats.text: Three sites, one story. The third has the wildest theory.
Abraham bargains from fifty righteous down to ten. Then fire rains.
beats.label: SULFUR AND FIRE

beats.text: One: Bab edh-Dhra, a walled Bronze Age town beside a huge cemetery.
beats.say: One: BAHB eh-DRAH, a walled Bronze Age town beside a huge cemetery.

beats.text: Two: Numeira, a small town nearby. Also abandoned in the Bronze Age.
beats.say: Two: noo-MAY-rah, a small town nearby. Also abandoned in the Bronze Age.

beats.text: Both lie southeast of the Dead Sea. But a rival theory looks north.
beats.label: SOUTH OR NORTH?

beats.text: Three: Tall el-Hammam, a large Middle Bronze Age city.
beats.say: Three: Tall el-Ham-MAHM, a large Middle Bronze Age city.

beats.text: A 2021 paper blames a meteor airburst there. Many scientists dispute it.
beats.source: 2021 Scientific Reports paper; disputed by many scientists

beats.text: Not proven: no dig has shown that any of these is Sodom.
beats.say: Not proven: no dig has shown that any of these is SOD-um.

beats.text: Two sites south, one north, all Bronze Age ruins.
Three Bronze Age ruins claim to be Sodom. South or north: your pick?
beats.say: Three Bronze Age ruins claim to be SOD-um. South or north: your pick?

youtube.title: 3 Ruins Claim to Be Sodom. Which One? 🗺️ #shorts
youtube.description:
Bab edh-Dhra, Numeira or Tall el-Hammam: three Bronze Age sites near the Dead Sea, each proposed as Sodom.
A 2021 airburst paper on Hammam is disputed by many scientists. No dig has shown any of them is Sodom.
#Sodom #BibleHistory #Archaeology #MythUnearthed
